_about: AI-generated derived enrichment for chinaosc2026 forum talks. Committed source, merged by source/chinaosc2026/build.py via source/enrichment.py. Kept SEPARATE from the verbatim extraction; the source title/abstract are never edited here. Each entry adds a one-line Chinese `summary` (distilled from the talk's own title/abstract, not a translation of the source) and `topics` from the controlled vocabulary (source/topics.json); the build attaches them under a talk's own `enrichment` container marked `generated_by: "ai"`.
_id_scheme: Key = '<forum code>#<0-based index of the talk within that forum's talks[]>', exactly the id the web app uses (web/src/lib/follow-store.ts talkId(); ForumDetail.tsx #talk-N is the same index, 1-based). Example: 'F1490#0' is the first talk of forum F1490.
